snapshot.stmt:
Let the quantities in \(\text{def:termination-budget}\) be fixed. For every finite \(\mathcal G\) and finite alphabets, the history-preserving symbolic compilation \(\operatorname{TCF}(\mathcal G,A,Y,P_{\mathrm{obs}})\) visits at most
\[
B_{\mathrm{state}}=2^n c\sum_{j=0}^{2n}\bigl\{2^{n+1}+n(\ell+1)+c+1\bigr\}^j
\]
literal complete trace states \(\kappa=(\mathcal H,F,c,q,\pi,\Lambda)\), counting every fixing-selection interleaving and provenance-bearing operation history. It produces at most \(N_{\mathrm{term}}=|\mathcal X_A||\mathcal X_Y|B_{\mathrm{state}}\) terminal packages. With \(S_{\mathrm{tot}}=N_{\mathrm{term}}(s+1)\), the common signed-subresultant CAD produces \(\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}\) within
\[
B_{\mathrm{tot}}=B_{\mathrm{state}}+\operatorname{CAD}(p,S_{\mathrm{tot}})
\]
state visits, projection, root-isolation, sign-evaluation steps, and output cells. Given \(\operatorname{Exact}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\), cell selection and Thom-encoded value or witness extraction over the real closure of the ordered field generated by \(\mathbf p\) terminate after finitely many exact sign decisions. No point computation is claimed for arbitrary unencoded population reals, and no polynomial-time claim is made.

defs.def:adjacent-swap: \(\operatorname{Swap}_{\kappa}(u,v)\) holds exactly when \(u\) and \(v\) are both fixable in the current \(\mathcal H\), \(u\notin\operatorname{an}_{\mathcal H}(C_v)\), \(v\notin\operatorname{an}_{\mathcal H}(C_u)\), the license contexts \(C_u\) and \(C_v\) agree on their common indicators, and both fixing denominators are supported in the same pre-restriction trace.
defs.def:exact-observed-specialization: Given \(\operatorname{Exact}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\), decide the finitely many integer-polynomial signs in \(\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}\) using rational arithmetic, algebraic-number arithmetic with the supplied square-free polynomials and isolating intervals, or the supplied exact-real sign oracle. Choose the unique cell containing \(p_o=P_{\mathrm{obs}}(o)\). On an identifying cell, represent its unique value \(z\), and on a negative cell choose \(\theta^0,\theta^1\) satisfying \(\mathsf W_j\), by Thom encodings over the real closure of the ordered field generated by the specialized coordinates \(\mathbf p\). These response coordinates are algebraic over that ordered input field; they are real algebraic over \(\mathbb Q\) when the observed cells are rational or real algebraic, but no such claim is made for transcendental exact-real cells. No operation on an arbitrary unencoded population real is defined.
defs.def:response-polynomial-fiber: Let \(\mathcal J=\mathcal E^{\leftrightarrow}(\mathcal G)\sqcup\mathcal V\sqcup\mathcal R\). For \(g\in\mathcal T_{\mathcal G}\) introduce \(\gamma_g\), and for \(h\in\mathcal J\) and \(1\leq k\leq K_{\mathcal G}\) introduce \(\rho_{h,k}\). For a full cell \((v,r)\), define \[p_{v,r}(\theta)=\sum_{g\in\mathcal T_{\mathcal G}}\sum_{u\in\{1,\ldots,K_{\mathcal G}\}^{\mathcal J}}\mathbf 1\{g(u)=(v,r)\}\gamma_g\prod_{h\in\mathcal J}\rho_{h,u_h},\qquad p_o(\theta)=\sum_{(v,r):\operatorname{proxy}(v,r)=o}p_{v,r}(\theta).\] Define \(q_{a,y}(\theta)\) by the same sum with the equation for \(A\) replaced by \(a\). With formal coordinates \(\mathbf p=(p_o)_o\), define \[\begin{aligned}\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p):={}&\bigwedge_{g\in\mathcal T_{\mathcal G}}(\gamma_g^2-\gamma_g=0)\ \wedge\ \sum_g\gamma_g=1\ \wedge\ \bigwedge_{h\in\mathcal J}\left(\bigwedge_{k=1}^{K_{\mathcal G}}\rho_{h,k}\geq0\ \wedge\ \sum_{k=1}^{K_{\mathcal G}}\rho_{h,k}=1\right)\\&\wedge\bigwedge_{(v,r)}p_{v,r}(\theta)>0\ \wedge\ \bigwedge_{o\in\mathcal X_{\mathcal O}}p_o(\theta)=p_o.\end{aligned}\] The product over individual edge and private factors enforces the published semi-Markovian independence structure, while the one-hot equations encode a finite union over fixed structural tables rather than a graph-wide latent mixture.
defs.def:symbolic-observed-partition: Conjoin the simplex formula \(p_o\geq0\), \(\sum_op_o=1\), and the feasible-projection formula \(\exists\theta\,\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\) with every quantifier-free output of \(\mathsf I_{a,y}\), refine their common sign-invariant CAD, and discard infeasible cells. The remaining pairwise-disjoint formulas \(\psi_1(\mathbf p),\ldots,\psi_J(\mathbf p)\) form \(\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}\). Each cell stores, for every \(a,y\), either the unique-value relation \(\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z)\) or the witness relation \(\mathsf W_j(\mathbf p,a,y,\theta^0,\theta^1)\).
defs.def:tcf-procedure: On formal input \((\mathcal G,A,Y,\mathbf p)\), start from every observed margin and partial-context trace kernel written as a rational expression in \(\mathbf p\). Recursively branch only by strict ancestral marginalization, restriction to a proper child of a nontrivial district decomposition, a licensed \(\Phi_v^{\lambda}\) update, or a delayed \(\Sigma_{c'}\) update that strictly extends the partial context. Retain the complete operation word and memoize only literal complete tuples \(\kappa=(\mathcal H,F,c,q,\pi,\Lambda)\), including the syntax of \(q\), \(\pi\), and every provenance entry in \(\Lambda\). An adjacent-swap optimization may merge two branches only after replaying both license orders from their common pre-swap state in a fixed canonical order and verifying literal equality of the two resulting complete tuples; fixing and selection are never commuted. For every terminal tuple and every \((a,y)\), append one package containing \(\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\), \(\mathsf I_{a,y}(\mathcal G;\mathbf p)\), \(\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z)\), and any candidate rational trace expression. Reuse the same scoped response-variable names across packages, concatenate all partition-generating formulas, and run one common signed-subresultant CAD. Store a rational trace expression only on cells where its equality to \(\mathsf V_{a,y}\) has been verified; otherwise store the unique-value graph, and store \(\mathsf W_j\) on negative cells. The notation \(\operatorname{TCF}(\mathcal G,A,Y,P_{\mathrm{obs}})\) denotes this symbolic object with formal names \(p_o=P_{\mathrm{obs}}(o)\); numerical cell selection is the separate exact specialization. The procedure neither names nor returns a colored hedge.
defs.def:terminal-qe-test: For every \(a\in\mathcal X_A\) and \(y\in\mathcal X_Y\), use disjoint copies \(\theta^0=(\gamma^0,\rho^0)\) and \(\theta^1=(\gamma^1,\rho^1)\) and eliminate precisely those response variables from \[\mathsf I_{a,y}(\mathcal G;\mathbf p):=\neg\exists\theta^0\,\exists\theta^1\left[\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta^0;\mathbf p)\wedge\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta^1;\mathbf p)\wedge q_{a,y}(\theta^0)\neq q_{a,y}(\theta^1)\right].\] The only free variables are the \(|\mathcal X_{\mathcal O}|\) coordinates \(\mathbf p\). Quantifier elimination returns a quantifier-free sign formula, not a numerical decision at an arbitrary population law. On its true region the value relation is \[\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z):=\exists\theta\left[\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\wedge z=q_{a,y}(\theta)\right],\] which has exactly one \(z\); on its false region the certificate formula is the unnegated doubled conjunction. A sample pair is extracted only after an exact specialization.
defs.def:termination-budget:
For the size quantities \((n,\ell,c,h,g,K_{\mathcal G},p,s)\), define
\[
L_{\mathrm{op}}=2^{n+1}+n(\ell+1)+c+1,
\qquad
B_{\mathrm{state}}=2^n c\sum_{j=0}^{2n}L_{\mathrm{op}}^j,
\]
\[
N_{\mathrm{term}}=|\mathcal X_A||\mathcal X_Y|B_{\mathrm{state}},
\qquad
S_{\mathrm{tot}}=N_{\mathrm{term}}(s+1),
\qquad
B_{\mathrm{tot}}=B_{\mathrm{state}}+\operatorname{CAD}(p,S_{\mathrm{tot}}).
\]
Here \(2^n c\) bounds the initial observed-margin and partial-context traces; the operation alphabet respectively bounds ancestral and district subset choices, vertex-license choices, strict context extensions, and one harmless terminal marker. The recursive word length \(2n\) counts every provenance-bearing marginalization, district restriction, fixing, and selection in its actual order. The quantity \(s\) bounds the binary encoding length of the partition-generating part of one terminal \((a,y)\)-package, including polynomial counts, degrees, integer coefficients, variable indices, Boolean connectives, and free observed-cell names. One common CAD receives the concatenated input of length at most \(S_{\mathrm{tot}}\), eliminates only the response variables, retains \(\mathbf p\), and is bounded by \(\operatorname{CAD}(p,S_{\mathrm{tot}})\). Exact point specialization is a separate finite sign computation under \(\operatorname{Exact}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\).
defs.def:trace-state: \(\kappa=(\mathcal H,F,c,q,\pi,\Lambda)\), where \(\mathcal H\) is the current CADMG, \(F\) is its fixed set, \(c\) is a partial assignment to missingness indicators, \(q\) is a normalized kernel on the random vertices of \(\mathcal H\), \(\pi\) is a finite expression in observed cells of \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), and \(\Lambda\) is an ordered list of pairs consisting of a label license and the pre-restriction trace that licensed it.

snapshot.stmt:
For a finite positive regular-maximal \(\mathcal G\) and supplied \(A,Y\), the history-preserving symbolic procedure \(\operatorname{TCF}\) constructs a finite semialgebraic partition
\[
\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}
\quad\text{of}\quad
\{\mathbf p:\exists\theta\,\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\}.
\]
For every compatible \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), every \(a\in\mathcal X_A\), and every \(y\in\mathcal X_Y\), its unique cell carries \(f_{a,j}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)\) if and only if \(\mathcal M\mapsto Q_a^{\mathcal M}(y)\) is constant on \(\mathfrak F(\mathcal G,P_{\mathrm{obs}})\); in that case
\[
f_{a,j}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)=Q_a^{\mathcal M}(y)
\quad\text{for every }\mathcal M\in\mathfrak F(\mathcal G,P_{\mathrm{obs}}).
\]
If the coordinate is not constant, the cell carries \(\mathsf W_j\). Under \(\operatorname{Exact}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\), a sample from \(\mathsf W_j\) decodes to strictly positive, individual-edge-factorized models \(\mathcal M_0,\mathcal M_1\) satisfying \(P_{\mathcal M_0}(\mathcal O)=P_{\mathcal M_1}(\mathcal O)=P_{\mathrm{obs}}\) and \(Q_a^{\mathcal M_0}(y)\neq Q_a^{\mathcal M_1}(y)\), and the partial diagnostic \(\operatorname{Compile}_{\mathrm{col}}\) terminates with either a checked record or an exhaustion tag. If every coordinate is constant for both \(a_0\) and \(a_1\), then the observed-law functional identifies the causal contrast:
\[
\tau_{s_Y}
=\sum_{y\in\mathcal X_Y}s_Y(y)
\{f_{a_1,j}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)-f_{a_0,j}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)\}.
\]
This is pointwise semialgebraic completeness over the observed-law fiber; it makes no graphwise colored-hedge completeness claim.

defs.def:certificate-compiler: Given an exact specialized negative-cell witness \(\omega=(a,y,\theta^0,\theta^1)\) and a finite retained operation history \(\mathcal T\), first decode \(\theta^0,\theta^1\) through their selected response tables and product laws over the individual edge and private factors, obtaining \(\mathcal M_0,\mathcal M_1\). Next enumerate, in a fixed prefix and vertex-subset order, every triple \((\kappa_*,D,D')\) occurring in \(\mathcal T\) and test the conjuncts of the candidate predicate \(\Delta(\omega,\mathcal T)=(\kappa_*,D,D')\). Trace equalities are tested after clearing the supported nonzero denominators, using the Thom encodings supplied by exact specialization. Return \((\operatorname{found}(\kappa_*,D,D'),\mathcal M_0,\mathcal M_1)\) for the first successful test and return \((\operatorname{exhausted},\mathcal M_0,\mathcal M_1)\) if the finite enumeration ends. This is a partial graphical diagnostic: neither tag asserts existence of a colored hedge, membership in \(\operatorname{CH}(\mathcal G,A,Y)\), realization of a forest by the decoded models, or alignment of the algebraic sample with a graphwise recursion failure.

For a full cell \((v,r)\), define \[p_{v,r}(\theta)=\sum_{g\in\mathcal T_{\mathcal G}}\sum_{u\in\{1,\ldots,K_{\mathcal G}\}^{\mathcal J}}\mathbf 1\{g(u)=(v,r)\}\gamma_g\prod_{h\in\mathcal J}\rho_{h,u_h},\qquad p_o(\theta)=\sum_{(v,r):\operatorname{proxy}(v,r)=o}p_{v,r}(\theta).\] Define \(q_{a,y}(\theta)\) by the same sum with the equation for \(A\) replaced by \(a\). With formal coordinates \(\mathbf p=(p_o)_o\), define \[\begin{aligned}\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p):={}&\bigwedge_{g\in\mathcal T_{\mathcal G}}(\gamma_g^2-\gamma_g=0)\ \wedge\ \sum_g\gamma_g=1\ \wedge\ \bigwedge_{h\in\mathcal J}\left(\bigwedge_{k=1}^{K_{\mathcal G}}\rho_{h,k}\geq0\ \wedge\ \sum_{k=1}^{K_{\mathcal G}}\rho_{h,k}=1\right)\\&\wedge\bigwedge_{(v,r)}p_{v,r}(\theta)>0\ \wedge\ \bigwedge_{o\in\mathcal X_{\mathcal O}}p_o(\theta)=p_o.\end{aligned}\] The product over individual edge and private factors enforces the published semi-Markovian independence structure, while the one-hot equations encode a finite union over fixed structural tables rather than a graph-wide latent mixture.
defs.def:symbolic-observed-partition: Conjoin the simplex formula \(p_o\geq0\), \(\sum_op_o=1\), and the feasible-projection formula \(\exists\theta\,\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\) with every quantifier-free output of \(\mathsf I_{a,y}\), refine their common sign-invariant CAD, and discard infeasible cells. The remaining pairwise-disjoint formulas \(\psi_1(\mathbf p),\ldots,\psi_J(\mathbf p)\) form \(\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}\). Each cell stores, for every \(a,y\), either the unique-value relation \(\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z)\) or the witness relation \(\mathsf W_j(\mathbf p,a,y,\theta^0,\theta^1)\).
defs.def:tcf-procedure: On formal input \((\mathcal G,A,Y,\mathbf p)\), start from every observed margin and partial-context trace kernel written as a rational expression in \(\mathbf p\). Recursively branch only by strict ancestral marginalization, restriction to a proper child of a nontrivial district decomposition, a licensed \(\Phi_v^{\lambda}\) update, or a delayed \(\Sigma_{c'}\) update that strictly extends the partial context. Retain the complete operation word and memoize only literal complete tuples \(\kappa=(\mathcal H,F,c,q,\pi,\Lambda)\), including the syntax of \(q\), \(\pi\), and every provenance entry in \(\Lambda\). An adjacent-swap optimization may merge two branches only after replaying both license orders from their common pre-swap state in a fixed canonical order and verifying literal equality of the two resulting complete tuples; fixing and selection are never commuted. For every terminal tuple and every \((a,y)\), append one package containing \(\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\), \(\mathsf I_{a,y}(\mathcal G;\mathbf p)\), \(\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z)\), and any candidate rational trace expression. Reuse the same scoped response-variable names across packages, concatenate all partition-generating formulas, and run one common signed-subresultant CAD. Store a rational trace expression only on cells where its equality to \(\mathsf V_{a,y}\) has been verified; otherwise store the unique-value graph, and store \(\mathsf W_j\) on negative cells. The notation \(\operatorname{TCF}(\mathcal G,A,Y,P_{\mathrm{obs}})\) denotes this symbolic object with formal names \(p_o=P_{\mathrm{obs}}(o)\); numerical cell selection is the separate exact specialization. The procedure neither names nor returns a colored hedge.
defs.def:terminal-qe-test: For every \(a\in\mathcal X_A\) and \(y\in\mathcal X_Y\), use disjoint copies \(\theta^0=(\gamma^0,\rho^0)\) and \(\theta^1=(\gamma^1,\rho^1)\) and eliminate precisely those response variables from \[\mathsf I_{a,y}(\mathcal G;\mathbf p):=\neg\exists\theta^0\,\exists\theta^1\left[\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta^0;\mathbf p)\wedge\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta^1;\mathbf p)\wedge q_{a,y}(\theta^0)\neq q_{a,y}(\theta^1)\right].\] The only free variables are the \(|\mathcal X_{\mathcal O}|\) coordinates \(\mathbf p\). On its true region the value relation is \[\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z):=\exists\theta\left[\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\wedge z=q_{a,y}(\theta)\right],\] which has exactly one \(z\); on its false region the certificate formula is the unnegated doubled conjunction. snapshot.stmt:

\[
P_{\mathcal M_0}(\mathcal O)=P_{\mathcal M_1}(\mathcal O)=P_{\mathrm{obs}},
\qquad
Q_a^{\mathcal M_0}(y)\neq Q_a^{\mathcal M_1}(y).
\]
Consequently \(Q_a(y)\) is not identified over the larger published ambient set \(\{\mathcal M\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{lm}}(\mathcal G):P_{\mathcal M}(\mathcal O)=P_{\mathrm{obs}}\}\). defs.def:exact-observed-specialization: Given \(\operatorname{Exact}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\), decide the finitely many integer-polynomial signs in \(\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}\) using rational arithmetic, algebraic-number arithmetic with the supplied square-free polynomials and isolating intervals, or the supplied exact-real sign oracle. Run one common signed-subresultant CAD on this base family alone, retaining \(\mathbf p\), to obtain the canonical cells \(\psi_j\) and their unique-value or witness relations. \[

\left[
\psi_j(\mathbf p)\wedge\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z)
\ \Longrightarrow\ D(\mathbf p)\neq0\ \wedge\ D(\mathbf p)z=N(\mathbf p)
\right].
\]

\]
literal complete trace states \(\kappa=(\mathcal H,F,c,q,\pi,\Lambda)\), counting every fixing-selection interleaving and provenance-bearing history. Independently of those traces, the single base feasibility/coordinate-constancy CAD constructs \(\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}\) within \(C_{\mathrm{base}}=\operatorname{CAD}(p,s)\) projection, root-isolation, sign-evaluation steps, and output cells. At most
\[
N_{\mathrm{check}}=|\mathcal X_A||\mathcal X_Y|B_{\mathrm{state}}C_{\mathrm{base}}
\]
whole-cell candidate-equality sentences are subsequently decided, and the total work is bounded by
\[
B_{\mathrm{tot}}=
B_{\mathrm{state}}+C_{\mathrm{base}}
+N_{\mathrm{check}}\operatorname{CAD}(p+1,s).
\]
Given \(\operatorname{Exact}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\), cell selection and Thom-encoded value or witness extraction over the real closure of the ordered field generated by \(\mathbf p\) terminate after finitely many exact sign decisions. No point computation is claimed for arbitrary unencoded population reals, and no polynomial-time claim is made.

defs.def:adjacent-swap: \(\operatorname{Swap}_{\kappa}(u,v)\) holds exactly when \(u\) and \(v\) are both fixable in the current \(\mathcal H\), \(u\notin\operatorname{an}_{\mathcal H}(C_v)\), \(v\notin\operatorname{an}_{\mathcal H}(C_u)\), the license contexts \(C_u\) and \(C_v\) agree on their common indicators, and both fixing denominators are supported in the same pre-restriction trace.
defs.def:exact-observed-specialization: Given \(\operatorname{Exact}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\), decide the finitely many integer-polynomial signs in \(\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}\) using rational arithmetic, algebraic-number arithmetic with the supplied square-free polynomials and isolating intervals, or the supplied exact-real sign oracle. Choose the unique cell containing \(p_o=P_{\mathrm{obs}}(o)\). On an identifying cell, represent its unique value \(z\), and on a negative cell choose \(\theta^0,\theta^1\) satisfying \(\mathsf W_j\), by Thom encodings over the real closure of the ordered field generated by the specialized coordinates \(\mathbf p\). These response coordinates are algebraic over that ordered input field; they are real algebraic over \(\mathbb Q\) when the observed cells are rational or real algebraic, but no such claim is made for transcendental exact-real cells. No operation on an arbitrary unencoded population real is defined.
defs.def:response-polynomial-fiber:
Let
\[
L_{\mathcal G}=\left|\mathcal X_{\mathcal V}\times\mathcal X_{\mathcal R}\right|,
\qquad
K_{\mathrm{ub}}(\mathcal G)=L_{\mathcal G}+|\mathcal X_A|(|\mathcal X_Y|-1),
\qquad
\mathcal J=\mathcal E^{\leftrightarrow}(\mathcal G)\sqcup\mathcal V\sqcup\mathcal R.
\]
The integer \(K_{\mathrm{ub}}(\mathcal G)\) is a universal factorwise upper bound, not a claimed sharp support size. For \(g\in\mathcal T_{\mathcal G}\) introduce \(\gamma_g\), and for \(h\in\mathcal J\) and \(1\leq k\leq K_{\mathrm{ub}}(\mathcal G)\) introduce \(\rho_{h,k}\). For a full cell \((v,r)\), define
\[
p_{v,r}(\theta)=
\sum_{g\in\mathcal T_{\mathcal G}}
\sum_{u\in\{1,\ldots,K_{\mathrm{ub}}(\mathcal G)\}^{\mathcal J}}
\mathbf 1\{g(u)=(v,r)\}\gamma_g\prod_{h\in\mathcal J}\rho_{h,u_h},
\qquad
p_o(\theta)=\sum_{(v,r):\operatorname{proxy}(v,r)=o}p_{v,r}(\theta).
\]
Define \(q_{a,y}(\theta)\) by the same product sum after replacing the selected equation for \(A\) by the constant \(a\). With formal observed coordinates \(\mathbf p=(p_o)_o\), set
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p):={}&
\bigwedge_{g\in\mathcal T_{\mathcal G}}(\gamma_g^2-\gamma_g=0)
\ \wedge\ \sum_g\gamma_g=1\\
&\wedge\bigwedge_{h\in\mathcal J}
\left(\bigwedge_{k=1}^{K_{\mathrm{ub}}(\mathcal G)}\rho_{h,k}\geq0
\ \wedge\ \sum_{k=1}^{K_{\mathrm{ub}}(\mathcal G)}\rho_{h,k}=1\right)\\
&\wedge\bigwedge_{(v,r)}p_{v,r}(\theta)>0
\ \wedge\ \bigwedge_{o\in\mathcal X_{\mathcal O}}p_o(\theta)=p_o.
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus every individual bidirected-edge or private factor has its own simplex and the joint latent law is the product over \(h\). The one-hot equations select one graph-wide tuple of label-compatible deterministic tables; they do not mix structural tables through an additional unrestricted district latent.
defs.def:symbolic-observed-partition: Conjoin the simplex formula \(p_o\geq0\), \(\sum_op_o=1\), and the feasible-projection formula \(\exists\theta\,\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\) with every quantifier-free output of \(\mathsf I_{a,y}\), refine their common sign-invariant CAD, and discard infeasible cells. The remaining pairwise-disjoint formulas \(\psi_1(\mathbf p),\ldots,\psi_J(\mathbf p)\) form \(\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}\). Each cell stores, for every \(a,y\), either the unique-value relation \(\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z)\) or the witness relation \(\mathsf W_j(\mathbf p,a,y,\theta^0,\theta^1)\).
defs.def:tcf-procedure:
On formal input \((\mathcal G,A,Y,\mathbf p)\), first construct the response-polynomial feasibility formula \(\exists\theta\,\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\) and the coordinate-constancy formulas \(\mathsf I_{a,y}(\mathcal G;\mathbf p)\) for all \((a,y)\). Run one common signed-subresultant CAD on this base family alone, retaining \(\mathbf p\), to obtain the canonical cells \(\psi_j\) and their unique-value or witness relations. This base partition is independent of every fixing trace.

After the base cells have been fixed, enumerate expression-discovery traces. Start from every supported observed margin and partial-context trace kernel written as a rational expression in \(\mathbf p\). Recursively branch only by strict ancestral marginalization, restriction to a proper child of a nontrivial district decomposition, a licensed \(\Phi_v^{\lambda}\) update, or a delayed \(\Sigma_{c'}\) update that strictly extends the partial context. Retain the complete operation word and memoize only literal complete tuples \(\kappa=(\mathcal H,F,c,q,\pi,\Lambda)\), including the syntax of \(q\), \(\pi\), and every provenance entry in \(\Lambda\). An adjacent-swap optimization may merge branches only after replaying both license orders from their common pre-swap state in a fixed canonical order and verifying literal equality of the complete resulting tuples. Fixing and selection are never commuted.

For a candidate trace expression \(r(\mathbf p)=N(\mathbf p)/D(\mathbf p)\), a base cell \(\psi_j\), and a coordinate \((a,y)\) whose cell relation is unique, use real-closed-field quantifier elimination to decide the whole-cell implication
\[
\forall\mathbf p\,\forall z\,
\left[
\psi_j(\mathbf p)\wedge\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z)
\ \Longrightarrow\ D(\mathbf p)\neq0\ \wedge\ D(\mathbf p)z=N(\mathbf p)
\right].
\]
Annotate \(\psi_j\) by \(r\) only if this implication is true. If no candidate passes, retain the unique-value graph \(\mathsf V_{a,y}\); on a nonconstant cell retain \(\mathsf W_j\). Trace enumeration and annotation never split, merge, or otherwise alter the base CAD cells. The notation \(\operatorname{TCF}(\mathcal G,A,Y,P_{\mathrm{obs}})\) denotes this symbolic partition and its verified annotations with formal names \(p_o=P_{\mathrm{obs}}(o)\). Numerical cell selection is the separate exact specialization. The procedure neither names nor returns a colored hedge.
defs.def:terminal-qe-test: For every \(a\in\mathcal X_A\) and \(y\in\mathcal X_Y\), use disjoint copies \(\theta^0=(\gamma^0,\rho^0)\) and \(\theta^1=(\gamma^1,\rho^1)\) and eliminate precisely those response variables from \[\mathsf I_{a,y}(\mathcal G;\mathbf p):=\neg\exists\theta^0\,\exists\theta^1\left[\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta^0;\mathbf p)\wedge\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta^1;\mathbf p)\wedge q_{a,y}(\theta^0)\neq q_{a,y}(\theta^1)\right].\] The only free variables are the \(|\mathcal X_{\mathcal O}|\) coordinates \(\mathbf p\). Quantifier elimination returns a quantifier-free sign formula, not a numerical decision at an arbitrary population law. On its true region the value relation is \[\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z):=\exists\theta\left[\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\wedge z=q_{a,y}(\theta)\right],\] which has exactly one \(z\); on its false region the certificate formula is the unnegated doubled conjunction. A sample pair is extracted only after an exact specialization.
defs.def:termination-budget:
For the size quantities \((n,\ell,c,h,g,K_{\mathrm{ub}}(\mathcal G),p,s)\), define
\[
L_{\mathrm{op}}=2^{n+1}+n(\ell+1)+c+1,
\qquad
B_{\mathrm{state}}=2^n c\sum_{j=0}^{2n}L_{\mathrm{op}}^j.
\]
Here \(2^n c\) bounds the initial observed-margin and partial-context traces, and the operation alphabet bounds ancestral and district subset choices, vertex-license choices, strict context extensions, and one harmless terminal marker. The recursive word length \(2n\) counts every provenance-bearing marginalization, district restriction, fixing, and selection in its actual order.

Let
\[
p=2\{g+hK_{\mathrm{ub}}(\mathcal G)\}+|\mathcal X_{\mathcal O}|.
\]
Let \(s\) be the maximum of the complete binary encoding length of the single trace-independent base feasibility/coordinate-constancy CAD input and the complete binary encoding length of any one whole-cell candidate-verification sentence generated by an operation word of length at most \(2n\), including its canonical cell formula, cleared numerator and denominator, polynomial counts, degrees, integer coefficients, variable indices, Boolean connectives, and free observed-cell names. Define
\[
C_{\mathrm{base}}=\operatorname{CAD}(p,s),
\qquad
N_{\mathrm{check}}=|\mathcal X_A||\mathcal X_Y|B_{\mathrm{state}}C_{\mathrm{base}},
\]
\[
B_{\mathrm{tot}}=
B_{\mathrm{state}}+C_{\mathrm{base}}
+N_{\mathrm{check}}\operatorname{CAD}(p+1,s).
\]
The first CAD is run once, before trace enumeration. Its number of output cells is at most \(C_{\mathrm{base}}\). Each subsequent annotation sentence uses at most one response vector, \(z\), and \(\mathbf p\), hence at most \(p+1\) variables, and no more than \(N_{\mathrm{check}}\) such sentences are tested. Exact point specialization is a separate finite sign computation under \(\operatorname{Exact}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\).
defs.def:trace-state: \(\kappa=(\mathcal H,F,c,q,\pi,\Lambda)\), where \(\mathcal H\) is the current CADMG, \(F\) is its fixed set, \(c\) is a partial assignment to missingness indicators, \(q\) is a normalized kernel on the random vertices of \(\mathcal H\), \(\pi\) is a finite expression in observed cells of \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), and \(\Lambda\) is an ordered list of pairs consisting of a label license and the pre-restriction trace that licensed it.

assumptions.ass:finite-alphabets: \(|\mathcal X_Z|<\infty\) for every \(Z\in\mathcal V\cup\mathcal R\cup\mathcal V^{\dagger}\).

snapshot.stmt:
For a finite positive regular-maximal \(\mathcal G\) and supplied \(A,Y\), the trace-independent base phase of \(\operatorname{TCF}\) constructs a finite semialgebraic partition
\[
\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}
\quad\text{of}\quad
\{\mathbf p:\exists\theta\,\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\},
\]
and the colored trace phase only annotates those fixed cells by expressions verified on the whole cell. \[

\quad\text{for every }\mathcal M\in\mathfrak F(\mathcal G,P_{\mathrm{obs}}).
\]

\[

=\sum_{y\in\mathcal X_Y}s_Y(y)
\{f_{a_1,j}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)-f_{a_0,j}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)\}.
\]

assumptions.ass:finite-alphabets: \(|\mathcal X_Z|<\infty\) for every \(Z\in\mathcal V\cup\mathcal R\cup\mathcal V^{\dagger}\).
assumptions.ass:acyclic: The directed part of \(\mathcal G\) is acyclic.
assumptions.ass:semimarkovian: \(\mathcal M\) has one exogenous factor shared by the two endpoints of each bidirected edge of \(\mathcal G\), one private exogenous factor for each substantive or missingness vertex, and all these factors are mutually independent.
assumptions.ass:proxy-consistency: For every partially observed \(Z\in\mathcal V\), \(Z^{\dagger}=Z\) when \(R_Z=1\) and \(Z^{\dagger}=\star\) when \(R_Z=0\).
assumptions.ass:label-semantics: Every label \((X,Z,R_X=0)\) in \(\mathcal G\) encodes that the structural mechanism for \(Z\) omits \(X\) in context \(R_X=0\).
assumptions.ass:regular: The label set of \(\mathcal G\) is regular.
assumptions.ass:maximal: The label set of \(\mathcal G\) is maximal.
assumptions.ass:strict-positivity: \(P_{\mathcal M}(v,r)>0\) for every \((v,r)\in\mathcal X_{\mathcal V}\times\mathcal X_{\mathcal R}\).

snapshot.stmt: For the worked member \(\mathcal G_\star=\mathcal G(\{C\},1)\), every compatible \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\) satisfies \[Q_a(y)=\sum_{c}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(c)\sum_bP_{\mathrm{obs}}(b\mid a,c,R_W=0)\sum_{a'}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(y\mid b,a',c,R_W=0)P_{\mathrm{obs}}(a'\mid c,R_W=0)=f_a^\star(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y).\] The derivation first records \(P(Y\mid\operatorname{do}(A),R_W)\), then selects \(R_W=0\), uses \(B_1\) as the front-door set conditional on \(C\), and averages over the unselected \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}(C)\). No de Aguas Proposition 4 certificate exists: the edge \(A\leftrightarrow Y\) remains an open length-one path in every \(\mathcal H_r[\underline A]\), so condition \(\mathrm{(v)}\) fails for every \(K,H,\{L_r\}_r\). The root-control procedure is inapplicable because \(C\to R_W\), so its required context variable is not a causal root. The TCF partition places every compatible observed law on an identifying cell carrying \(f_a^\star\).

defs.def:da4-certificate-functional: \(\operatorname{DA4}(\mathcal G,A,Y)\) consists of every \(\xi=(K,H,\{L_r\}_r)\) satisfying de Aguas et al. Proposition 4 conditions \(\mathrm{(i)}\)--\(\mathrm{(v)}\): the inclusion and exclusion rule for \(L_r\), the no-descendant condition in \(\mathcal G_r\), and the three stated d-separations in \(\mathcal G_r[\overline A]\) and \(\mathcal H_r[\underline A]\). For such \(\xi\), \[f^{\mathrm{DA4}}_{a,\xi}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)=\sum_{r\in\operatorname{supp}(R_K)}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(R_K=r)\sum_{\ell}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(L_r^{\dagger}=\ell\mid R_K=r,R_{M_r}=1)P_{\mathrm{obs}}(Y=y\mid A=a,L_r^{\dagger}=\ell,R_K=r,R_{M_r}=1,R_H=0).\]
defs.def:eipfd-star-functional: For \(\mathcal G_\star=\mathcal G(\{C\},1)\), define \[f_a^\star(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)=\sum_{c\in\mathcal X_C}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(c)\sum_{b\in\mathcal X_{B_1}}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(b\mid a,c,R_W=0)\sum_{a'\in\mathcal X_A}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(y\mid b,a',c,R_W=0)P_{\mathrm{obs}}(a'\mid c,R_W=0).\] The operation order attached to this expression is: derive \(P(Y\mid\operatorname{do}(A),R_W)\) with its pre-selection trace, select \(R_W=0\), apply front-door adjustment through \(B_1\) conditional on \(C\), and average using the unselected marginal \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}(C)\).
defs.def:endogenous-proxy-frontdoor-class: \(\mathfrak G_{\mathrm{EIPFD}}=\{\mathcal G(H,m):H\in\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{log}},\ m\geq1\}\), where \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{log}}\) is the set of nonempty finite always-observed DAGs with at least one \(C\to R_W\) and with no arrow from \(H\) to a vertex outside \(H\cup\{R_W\}\). Each \(\mathcal G(H,m)\) contains the Figure 3(b) module on \(A,Y,Z,W,R_W,R_Z\), replaces \(A\to Y\) by \(A\to B_1\to\cdots\to B_m\to Y\), adds \(A\leftrightarrow Y\), retains \(W^{\dagger}\), and keeps the label \(R_W=0\) on \(W\to A\). All \(B_j\) and all vertices of \(H\) are always observed. The member \(\mathcal G_\star=\mathcal G(\{C\},1)\) has exactly the additional vertices \(C,B_1\) and arrows \(C\to R_W\), \(A\to B_1\to Y\), and \(A\leftrightarrow Y\).
defs.def:figure3b-witness: \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{3b}}\) has substantive vertices \(\{A,Y,Z,W\}\), indicators \(\{R_W,R_Z\}\), their observed proxies, arrows \(R_W\to A\), \(Z\to A\), \(Z\to W\), \(W\to A\), \(A\to Y\), edges \(W\leftrightarrow Y\) and \(R_Z\leftrightarrow Y\), and label \(R_W=0\) on \(W\to A\); \(P_{\mathrm{3b}}\) is any compatible strictly positive observed law.
defs.def:root-control-functional: \(\operatorname{RC}(\mathcal G,A,Y)\) holds when every label context variable is observed and parentless and the published context-specific algorithm returns \(f_{a,c}^{\mathrm{ID}}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)\) in every context \(c\). Its published aggregate is \[f_a^{\mathrm{RC}}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)=\sum_c P_{\mathrm{obs}}(C=c)f_{a,c}^{\mathrm{ID}}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y).\]
defs.def:tcf-procedure:
On formal input \((\mathcal G,A,Y,\mathbf p)\), first construct the response-polynomial feasibility formula \(\exists\theta\,\mathsf C_{\mathcal G}(\theta;\mathbf p)\) and the coordinate-constancy formulas \(\mathsf I_{a,y}(\mathcal G;\mathbf p)\) for all \((a,y)\). Run one common signed-subresultant CAD on this base family alone, retaining \(\mathbf p\), to obtain the canonical cells \(\psi_j\) and their unique-value or witness relations. This base partition is independent of every fixing trace.

After the base cells have been fixed, enumerate expression-discovery traces. Start from every supported observed margin and partial-context trace kernel written as a rational expression in \(\mathbf p\). Recursively branch only by strict ancestral marginalization, restriction to a proper child of a nontrivial district decomposition, a licensed \(\Phi_v^{\lambda}\) update, or a delayed \(\Sigma_{c'}\) update that strictly extends the partial context. Retain the complete operation word and memoize only literal complete tuples \(\kappa=(\mathcal H,F,c,q,\pi,\Lambda)\), including the syntax of \(q\), \(\pi\), and every provenance entry in \(\Lambda\). An adjacent-swap optimization may merge branches only after replaying both license orders from their common pre-swap state in a fixed canonical order and verifying literal equality of the complete resulting tuples. Fixing and selection are never commuted.

For a candidate trace expression \(r(\mathbf p)=N(\mathbf p)/D(\mathbf p)\), a base cell \(\psi_j\), and a coordinate \((a,y)\) whose cell relation is unique, use real-closed-field quantifier elimination to decide the whole-cell implication
\[
\forall\mathbf p\,\forall z\,
\left[
\psi_j(\mathbf p)\wedge\mathsf V_{a,y}(\mathbf p,z)
\ \Longrightarrow\ D(\mathbf p)\neq0\ \wedge\ D(\mathbf p)z=N(\mathbf p)
\right].
\]
Annotate \(\psi_j\) by \(r\) only if this implication is true. If no candidate passes, retain the unique-value graph \(\mathsf V_{a,y}\); on a nonconstant cell retain \(\mathsf W_j\). Trace enumeration and annotation never split, merge, or otherwise alter the base CAD cells. The notation \(\operatorname{TCF}(\mathcal G,A,Y,P_{\mathrm{obs}})\) denotes this symbolic partition and its verified annotations with formal names \(p_o=P_{\mathrm{obs}}(o)\). Numerical cell selection is the separate exact specialization. The procedure neither names nor returns a colored hedge.

snapshot.stmt: On the common finite, strictly positive regular-maximal labeled-missingness subclass, TCF is a strict class-relative extension of the de Aguas Proposition 4 criterion and an embedding of the Mokhtarian observed-root theorem. More precisely, for every finite positive regular-maximal \(\mathcal G\), compatible \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), treatment value \(a\), outcome value \(y\), and \(\xi\in\operatorname{DA4}(\mathcal G,A,Y)\), the unique TCF cell \(\psi_j\in\mathscr P_{\mathcal G,A,Y}\) carries \[f_{a,j}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)=f^{\mathrm{DA4}}_{a,\xi}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y).\] Whenever \(\operatorname{RC}(\mathcal G,A,Y)\) holds, the same cell carries \(f_{a,j}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)=f_a^{\mathrm{RC}}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)\). The de Aguas containment is strict on \(\mathfrak G_{\mathrm{EIPFD}}\): for every \(\mathcal G(H,m)\) and every compatible \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), \(\operatorname{DA4}(\mathcal G(H,m),A,Y)=\varnothing\), while the TCF cell carries \[\sum_hP_{\mathrm{obs}}(h)\sum_bP_{\mathrm{obs}}(b\mid a,h,R_W=0)\sum_{a'}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(y\mid b,a',h,R_W=0)P_{\mathrm{obs}}(a'\mid h,R_W=0),\] where \(b\) ranges over \(B_1\). The arrow \(C\to R_W\) shows that the observed-root premise is inapplicable to this family; it is not a strictness claim about the complete published root-control domain. For \(H=\{C\}\) and \(m=1\), the displayed functional is exactly \(f_a^\star(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)\) of \(\text{prop:eipfd-star-worked}\).

defs.def:da4-certificate-functional: \(\operatorname{DA4}(\mathcal G,A,Y)\) consists of every \(\xi=(K,H,\{L_r\}_r)\) satisfying de Aguas et al. Proposition 4 conditions \(\mathrm{(i)}\)--\(\mathrm{(v)}\): the inclusion and exclusion rule for \(L_r\), the no-descendant condition in \(\mathcal G_r\), and the three stated d-separations in \(\mathcal G_r[\overline A]\) and \(\mathcal H_r[\underline A]\). For such \(\xi\), \[f^{\mathrm{DA4}}_{a,\xi}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)=\sum_{r\in\operatorname{supp}(R_K)}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(R_K=r)\sum_{\ell}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(L_r^{\dagger}=\ell\mid R_K=r,R_{M_r}=1)P_{\mathrm{obs}}(Y=y\mid A=a,L_r^{\dagger}=\ell,R_K=r,R_{M_r}=1,R_H=0).\]
defs.def:eipfd-star-functional: For \(\mathcal G_\star=\mathcal G(\{C\},1)\), define \[f_a^\star(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)=\sum_{c\in\mathcal X_C}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(c)\sum_{b\in\mathcal X_{B_1}}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(b\mid a,c,R_W=0)\sum_{a'\in\mathcal X_A}P_{\mathrm{obs}}(y\mid b,a',c,R_W=0)P_{\mathrm{obs}}(a'\mid c,R_W=0).\] The operation order attached to this expression is: derive \(P(Y\mid\operatorname{do}(A),R_W)\) with its pre-selection trace, select \(R_W=0\), apply front-door adjustment through \(B_1\) conditional on \(C\), and average using the unselected marginal \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}(C)\).
defs.def:endogenous-proxy-frontdoor-class: \(\mathfrak G_{\mathrm{EIPFD}}=\{\mathcal G(H,m):H\in\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{log}},\ m\geq1\}\), where \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{log}}\) is the set of nonempty finite always-observed DAGs with at least one \(C\to R_W\) and with no arrow from \(H\) to a vertex outside \(H\cup\{R_W\}\). Each \(\mathcal G(H,m)\) contains the Figure 3(b) module on \(A,Y,Z,W,R_W,R_Z\), replaces \(A\to Y\) by \(A\to B_1\to\cdots\to B_m\to Y\), adds \(A\leftrightarrow Y\), retains \(W^{\dagger}\), and keeps the label \(R_W=0\) on \(W\to A\). All \(B_j\) and all vertices of \(H\) are always observed. The member \(\mathcal G_\star=\mathcal G(\{C\},1)\) has exactly the additional vertices \(C,B_1\) and arrows \(C\to R_W\), \(A\to B_1\to Y\), and \(A\leftrightarrow Y\).
defs.def:figure3b-witness: \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{3b}}\) has substantive vertices \(\{A,Y,Z,W\}\), indicators \(\{R_W,R_Z\}\), their observed proxies, arrows \(R_W\to A\), \(Z\to A\), \(Z\to W\), \(W\to A\), \(A\to Y\), edges \(W\leftrightarrow Y\) and \(R_Z\leftrightarrow Y\), and label \(R_W=0\) on \(W\to A\); \(P_{\mathrm{3b}}\) is any compatible strictly positive observed law.
defs.def:observational-fiber: \(\mathfrak F(\mathcal G,P_{\mathrm{obs}})=\{\mathcal M\in\mathfrak M_{+}^{\mathrm{rm}}(\mathcal G):P_{\mathcal M}(\mathcal O)=P_{\mathrm{obs}}\}\).
defs.def:positive-rm-class: \(\mathfrak M_{+}^{\mathrm{rm}}(\mathcal G)=\{\mathcal M\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{lm}}(\mathcal G):|\mathcal X_Z|<\infty\text{ for every }Z\in\mathcal V\cup\mathcal R\cup\mathcal V^{\dagger},\ \mathcal G\text{ is regular and maximal},\ P_{\mathcal M}(v,r)>0\text{ for every }(v,r)\in\mathcal X_{\mathcal V}\times\mathcal X_{\mathcal R}\}\).
defs.def:root-control-functional: \(\operatorname{RC}(\mathcal G,A,Y)\) holds when every label context variable is observed and parentless and the published context-specific algorithm returns \(f_{a,c}^{\mathrm{ID}}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)\) in every context \(c\). Its published aggregate is \[f_a^{\mathrm{RC}}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y)=\sum_c P_{\mathrm{obs}}(C=c)f_{a,c}^{\mathrm{ID}}(P_{\mathrm{obs}})(y).\]

snapshot.stmt: When \(\mathcal R=\varnothing\), \(\mathcal V^{\dagger}=\varnothing\), and the label set is empty, the color and context components are vacuous and every rational trace returned by the graphical part of TCF is the corresponding ordinary \(\operatorname{ID}\) fixing expression. snapshot.stmt: Whenever \(\operatorname{RC}(\mathcal G,A,Y)\) holds and every context-specific graph is identifying, delayed restriction is unnecessary. defs.def:context-selection: For a missingness assignment \(c'\) compatible with the current trace, \(\Sigma_{c'}(\kappa)\) restricts \(q\) and \(\pi\) to \(c'\), normalizes on the positive selected cell, deletes the edges carrying labels activated by \(c'\), and retains every earlier entry of \(\Lambda\).

snapshot.stmt: The universal binary-witness assertion is false, and the smallest substantive alphabet vector is not determined by the color and district structure of a colored hedge alone. There exist a finite regular-maximal graph \(\mathcal G\), a hedge in \(\operatorname{CH}(\mathcal G,A,Y)\), and a strictly positive compatible \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\) for which two models in \(\mathfrak F(\mathcal G,P_{\mathrm{obs}})\) have different \(Q_a\), but no model matching \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\) can make every substantive variable binary. More generally, an always-observed substantive coordinate requires at least the cardinality of its observed support, and a partially observed coordinate \(Z\) requires at least \(|\operatorname{supp}(Z^{\dagger}\mid R_Z=1)|\). Under strict positivity these lower bounds equal the declared substantive alphabet cardinalities.

defs.def:binary-response-handle: Begin with the response-function cells indexed by \((\mathcal F,\mathcal F',\chi,T)\in\operatorname{CH}(\mathcal G,A,Y)\); impose the polynomial equalities for every observed proxy trace and every color deletion; then use label-preserving output randomization with parameter \(\varepsilon\) and alphabet lifting to search for a two-state substantive encoding without specifying its response tables in advance.
defs.def:causal-query: For \(a\in\mathcal X_A\), set \(Q_a^{\mathcal M}(y)=P_{\mathcal M}(Y=y\mid\operatorname{do}(A=a))\), and set \(\tau_{s_Y}=\sum_{y\in\mathcal X_Y}s_Y(y)\{Q_{a_1}^{\mathcal M}(y)-Q_{a_0}^{\mathcal M}(y)\}\).
defs.def:colored-hedge: \(\operatorname{CH}(\mathcal G,A,Y)\) is the set of tuples \((\mathcal F,\mathcal F',\chi,T)\) such that \(\mathcal F'\subseteq\mathcal F\) are equally rooted \(C\)-forests, \(\mathcal F\cap A\neq\varnothing\), \(\mathcal F'\cap A=\varnothing\), their roots are ancestors of \(Y\) after intervention on \(A\), \(\chi\) assigns every label-sensitive edge its missingness context, and \(T\) is a prefix-closed collection of observed traces on which every color used by the two forests is licensed.

snapshot.stmt:
Let \(\mathcal M\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{lm}}(\mathcal G)\) have finite endogenous alphabets and mutually independent individual-edge and private factors indexed by \(\mathcal J=\mathcal E^{\leftrightarrow}(\mathcal G)\sqcup\mathcal V\sqcup\mathcal R\). For the supplied arbitrary real score map \(s_Y:\mathcal X_Y\to\mathbb R\), write
\[
L_{\mathcal G}=\left|\mathcal X_{\mathcal V}\times\mathcal X_{\mathcal R}\right|,
\qquad
K_{\tau,\mathrm{ub}}(\mathcal G)=L_{\mathcal G}+1.
\]
There is a label-compatible deterministic response representation \(\widetilde{\mathcal M}\) in which every factor has support at most the target-only universal upper bound \(K_{\tau,\mathrm{ub}}(\mathcal G)\), the factors remain mutually independent, and simultaneously
\[
P_{\widetilde{\mathcal M}}(V=v,R=r)=P_{\mathcal M}(V=v,R=r)
\quad\text{for every }(v,r),
\qquad
\tau_{s_Y}^{\widetilde{\mathcal M}}=\tau_{s_Y}^{\mathcal M}.
\]
No rationality or algebraicity condition is imposed on the values of \(s_Y\). The bound preserves the single score contrast and the full-data law; it does not assert simultaneous preservation of every coordinate \(Q_a^{\mathcal M}(y)\), and it is not claimed sharp.

defs.def:published-lm-class: \(\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{lm}}(\mathcal G)\) is the published ambient class of semi-Markovian labeled-missingness SCMs on the finite vertex graph \(\mathcal G\): endogenous and exogenous state spaces may be measurable categorical or continuous standard Borel spaces, structural maps are measurable, the individual bidirected-edge and private exogenous factors are mutually independent, the proxy equations satisfy proxy consistency, and every labeled mechanism deletion has the semantics encoded by \(\mathcal G\). Finiteness of endogenous alphabets, strict positivity of every full-data cell, and regular-maximality are not part of this ambient definition.
